static_findings.only_physics_manager_mutation: SetNeverDropContacts(true) requests generated-contact data retention including pairs without per-link sensor; compute/transport overhead can change
static_findings.contact_source_time_preserved_separately: ContactState.info source_contact_time_s plus epoch; packet stamp remains WorldUpdateEnd; assessor allows and reports offset 0..0.002 seconds

resolved_review_findings: Source model/link association changed from per-publisher Header.seq to exact nanosecond stamp keys, with equal unique cardinalities.
Contact source time is assessed and actual offset range reported instead of treating wrapper stamp as unproven coincidence.
A report cannot pass receipt after nonzero roslaunch exit; required bag topics and nonempty messages are checked.
Raw probe observations saved before gate indexing so malformed evidence is retained; nonempty/length/finite checks added for measured contact arrays and body arrays.
Fixture seed is explicitly passed as --seed 260926003.
Outer main catches allocated preparation failure, durably writes failure receipt and ledgers, and refuses identity reuse.

review_test_attempts.result: harness NameError while parent concurrently replaced seq join by stamp_key; no file, ROS or evidence modification; discarded stale harness assumptions
current frozen assessor AST: one baseline plus five negative mutations all behave as expected; durable preparation failure and immutable identity tests pass

remaining_limits: Preflight is not a runtime qualification. The root must run the new bounded Q01 identity and retain failures, raw data, bag, receipt and cleanup evidence.
No robot exists in this fixture. A pass does not establish contact coverage for M2 chassis/wheels, pose-set drive collision response, swept collisions, or formal safety.
SetNeverDropContacts retains generated engine contacts; collision masks, disabled self collision, engine discretization, contact-point truncation and pre-step/post-step distinctions remain.
Contact time is allowed to precede packet time by at most one 0.002 s physics step; do not label all contacts exactly simultaneous with post-step poses.
The negative pre-touch gate proves at least one empty packet before 0.2 s, not a statistical false-positive rate or absence of every possible false contact.
State snapshots are 50 Hz, not every physics step. Contact packets are 500 Hz; downstream compound geometry must use the correct timestamp and account for the allowed phase offset.
Probe stores pose, linear body velocity and contact vectors; angular velocity remains in rosbag. The driver may set poses so body velocity need not equal finite pose derivative.
Body contact forces are not reported and no physical tire/friction calibration is qualified.
